guideline: Images are rated in two aspects: (1) Semantic Consistency (SC) assesses how well the generated image aligns with the given conditions, such as prompts and subject tokens, ensuring coherence and relevance to the specified criteria according to the task. (2) Perceptual Quality (PQ) evaluates the extent to which the generated image appears visually authentic and conveys a sense of naturalness.
Human raters score each image on Semantic Consistency and Perceptual Quality according to task‑specific guidelines, then average the three ratings.
